page_title: Helen B. Schleman Hall of Student Services

page_text_observation.current exterior image: Building exterior available on official Purdue Events page.

visual_observations_from_reference_image: Red brick wall fields with prominent light limestone horizontal bands between visible storeys.
Three visible above-grade levels in the photograph; this is a visual interpretation, not a measured count.
Red clay tile roof with multiple intersecting low-pitch roof sections over connected wings.
Dark window openings set in repeated vertical bays; limestone frames/bands organize the façade.
Covered main entry with brick piers, pale stone bases and a broad projecting canopy.
method_and_limits: Official Purdue Events image used for visual architectural vocabulary only. The photo is not georeferenced, does not establish exact dimensions, roof sections, façade orientation or entry coordinates. GIS remains the footprint source.
